name: Monbit
description: A tiny e-ink Tamagotchi-like device built around an ESP32.
about: Monbit is a personal project created to learn embedded development, hardware prototyping, and product design. The goal is not only to create a device, but also to explore the full product development process. From firmware and electronics to CAD design and physical prototype.

name: pyiconlaser
description: Python wrapper for the TYKMA ICON Interface HTTP/TCPIP API used by industrial laser marking systems.
about: This project started from a real production need: integrating a TYKMA laser marking system into a Python workflow. Instead of repeatedly working with the HTTP/TCPIP and it's quirks, I wanted to create a clean, reusable Python library that could also be useful for similar integrations in the future.

name: Jimverse web

about: I have decided that it's time to have a website. As a software developer, I think it's necessery and it has been a fun so far! :)
